units: <cite ref="Temurah 24a:31">Tem. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>דקא טרח טי׳ וכ׳</he> because he would undertake a labor unfit for him (on the Holy Day).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 93b:9">B. Mets. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>לט׳ יתירתא</he> with reference to special painstaking.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 13a:13">M. Kat. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>מועד משום ט׳ ולא ט׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. only <he>משום ט׳</he>) in the festive week it is forbidden only for being a labor to some extent; a. fr.
